method: Half-contrast contours measured directly on the native photograph. No inferred module grid, reconstructed symbol, or payload.

frame.coordinates: Original unrotated image in px, origin at top-left pixel corner, x right, y down; pixel [column,row] has center (column+0.5,row+0.5). No rescaling or rectification.
frame.fill: Paint in field order. Each polygon is [outer,hole,...], closed implicitly. Outers run clockwise on screen; holes run counterclockwise. Separate polygons are unioned.

photometry.samples: Decoded RGB code values, Y=0.299R+0.587G+0.114B. Opaque native crop: x=[949,1059), y=[361,531), in pixel indices.
photometry.tile: Outer boundary at half the contrast between local quiet-paper and the undisturbed label. Label level interpolates column-median profiles above and below the tile. Interior print does not perforate this underlay.
photometry.dark: Half contrast between the quiet-paper plane and an ink plane anchored by the medians of three visible solid ink cores. A guard in the clear perimeter only excludes the surrounding label. The globe partition selects whole components and clips no ink.
photometry.sampling: Range-preserving cubic Hermite interpolation of normalized native contrast (average of the two axis orders); marching squares at 1/8 px with interpolated crossings and a bilinear saddle decider. Simplification at most 0.05 px, tighter close to native sample centers; rounded to 0.01 px. No morphology or grid snapping of the traced ink.
photometry.limitation: Coordinates describe photographic tone transitions, not recovered module edges. Blur, WebP sampling and foreshortening make thin connections and small openings threshold-dependent.

levels.coordinates: For the following fits, u=column-1005 and v=row-446 at integer source array indices (not pixel-corner coordinates).
levels.paper_Y: 224.874413 + 0.042692982*u + 0.001896094*v. Robust plane fit to quiet bands across columns 972 through 1040, within 2.5 rows of y=381+0.057*(column-972) and y=509+0.05*(column-972).
levels.outside_Y: Column medians in rows [362,369) and [523,530), filtered horizontally by an 11-sample Gaussian, sigma 1.8 px, edge replication. Interpolate in row between 365 and 526.

verification.reference: Measured primary pixels, not a code master. Reference tile: fill the outermost paper-to-label midpoint contour. Reference dark: (paper_Y-Y)/(paper_Y-ink_Y) >= 0.5 inside that footprint.
verification.flattening: Independent scan conversion of serialized compound polygons. A native pixel is foreground if at least half of its 16x16 evenly spaced sample centers are covered. FP = extra rendered foreground; FN = missing measured foreground.
verification.independent_comparison: Global Otsu on original rounded Y, in the guarded print window x=[969,1044), y=[384,507): cutoff 156, dark IoU 0.945520. Correlation of 16x ink coverage with the original normalized darkness: 0.963518.
verification.uncertainty: Sweeping the normalized cutoff from 0.40 to 0.60 changes 308 tile-boundary centers in the 18700-pixel crop and 944 dark/light centers in the 9225-pixel print window. Dark support ranges from 3115 to 4059 centers. All 16x tile and dark disagreements at the 0.50 cutoff fall in these bands. This is threshold sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.
verification.topology: 54 simple rings, 3081 vertices; no crossings, touching rings, repeated closure, misnested holes, or overlapping dark fills. The globe has 10 openings at 0.50; it has 9 at 0.60. Weak bridges elsewhere likewise change with threshold.
verification.decode: Offline OpenCV 5.0.0 readers returned no payload on the source or on the flattened paths. Detection on aspect-corrected views did not establish a decode. No decoded data or decoder-produced bitmap contributed to geometry.

fields.text: Photographed light tile footprint under the ink, with its sloping edges and rounded corners.
Visible dark print around the center emblem, including finder outlines, their separated dark centers and irregular data marks.
Isolated center globe: the photographed rim and graticule, with light openings preserved as holes.
